ModMetaData.name: IsoRim Material and LOD | 材质与细节分级
ModMetaData.author: 水表狂魔
ModMetaData.description:
【中文】版本 0.4.0 · API 77 · RimWorld 1.7
为 IsoRim 的普通静态建筑模型添加法线贴图与两／三档 LOD。近景使用烘焙法线表现凹槽、接缝等表面细节；远景按屏幕占比切换预先制作的简化模型，并用滞回减少临界位置的反复切换。
本 Mod 是扩展框架，需要模型包明确配置材质和各档网格。不会自动替换全部建筑、生成法线贴图或自动减面。通过 IsoRim 公开 API 接入；本附加 Mod 不使用 Harmony 补丁或内部反射。
【安装】安装说明：已核对更新后的工坊 IsoRim API 77，本版针对配套 DLL 做精确兼容校验。直接订阅并更新 IsoRim Waylith 和本 Mod 即可，无需手动安装 GitHub 版。等待 Steam 下载完成后重启游戏；此前安装过本地 IsoRim 的玩家，请停用本地副本，避免重复启用。 详见 INSTALL.md。版本／散列不匹配时保留原生画法。 着色器由本子 Mod 维护；IsoRim 内部着色器约定不保证稳定，更新后可能需要适配。版本或资产失效时保留原生画法，最多记录警告。 加载顺序：Harmony → 配套 IsoRim → 本 Mod → 兼容模型包。
支持 IsoRimZ 地面层与上层的普通静态建筑：当前层按屏幕大小分级，可见下层默认用最远档（可关闭），隐藏层暂停 LOD，窥视层继续更新。0.4.0 新增动态模型材质／LOD 服务，需模型包主动接入；不包含完整 PBR、自动减面或纹理卸载，不承诺 FPS 提升。仓库另附可选的箱体示例包。
动态服务：兼容载具包独立启用时保留基础迷彩 3D 和 LOD0；同时启用本扩展时，法线／局部 AO 材质与自动 LOD 由本扩展负责。本扩展不依赖 Vehicles.dll；迷彩解释、炮塔、后坐及升级由载具包负责。
【English】Version 0.4.0 · API 77 · RimWorld 1.7
Adds baked normal maps and two- or three-level LOD to ordinary static building models in IsoRim. Normal maps add surface detail at close range; prepared lower-detail meshes are selected by screen size, with hysteresis to reduce switching near thresholds.
This is an extension framework. Model packs must explicitly supply and configure materials and LOD meshes. It does not replace every building, generate normal maps, or simplify meshes automatically. The addon uses public IsoRim APIs, with no addon Harmony patches or private reflection.
INSTALLATION: This version checks the exact matching Workshop IsoRim API 77 DLL. Subscribe to and update IsoRim Waylith and this addon; manual GitHub installation is no longer required. Wait for Steam downloads to finish and restart the game. If you previously installed local IsoRim, disable that duplicate. See INSTALL.md. Host version/hash mismatches retain native rendering. This addon owns its shader. Internal IsoRim shader conventions are not guaranteed stable; updates may require adaptation. Invalid assets or host mismatch fall back to native rendering with warnings. Load order: Harmony → matching IsoRim → this addon → compatible model packs.
Supports ordinary static buildings on IsoRimZ ground and upper floors: screen-size LOD on the viewed floor, optional lowest LOD on visible lower floors, suspended LOD on hidden floors, and continued updates while peeking. Version 0.4.0 adds an optional dynamic material/LOD service for explicitly integrated model packs. This is not a full PBR implementation and includes no automatic mesh reduction or texture eviction. No FPS improvement is promised. An optional crate example pack is included in the repository.
Dynamic service: compatible vehicle packs retain basic camouflage 3D at LOD0 without this addon. Enabling it provides normal/local-AO materials and automatic LOD. No Vehicles.dll dependency; paint interpretation, turrets, recoil and upgrades remain in the vehicle adapter.
